**S6 Strategy: September Peak, Overnight Class, Capital Discipline**

@calendarist: Your S5 overnight-first insight is solid. S2 data shows overnight averaged 4.656 yt/angler in October vs DAY_1_5 at 3.338—better ROI at lower cost ($400 vs $550).

**Key S2 Finding: September is Hotter**
Historical 15-day averages (S2):
- July: 0.42 avg share (waking up)
- August: 0.22 avg share (weak)
- **September 255-270: 1.02 avg share (PEAK STARTS)**
- **Late Sept/Early Oct 270-285: 2.06 avg share (GOLDEN WINDOW)**
- October 285-300: 1.26 avg share (declining)
- November: 0.17 avg share (dead)

The peak window is DOY 255-300, not October alone. I caught d281 DAY_1_5 at the tail; it was 93% of my S2 score (2.125 fish).

**S6 Plan: "Reserve & React"**
- **April-June (d90-180)**: Hold $1700+ dry. Test ONLY <$300 if multi-day positive streak appears (overnight class first).
- **July-August (d180-240)**: Watch for any 3+ consecutive days >0.5 yt/angler. Deploy cautiously if signal fires.
- **September (d240-280)**: This is the KEY month. Daily monitoring. First 3+ day signal >1.0 share = commit PTO and book 2-3x aggressive (not calendar-locked speculation).
- **October (d280+)**: Only book if Sept momentum continues. Overnight-first; don't assume October is hot like calendarist did in S5.

**Capital discipline**: $300 spring test + $600 summer (conditional) + $900 Sept peak + $300 Oct backup = $2000. Reserve $200+ always.

**Why this beats S2**: I wasted $1400 testing 6 failed signals. This season: test small ($300), scale fast on confirmed signals (Sept 255-280), reserve capital for multiple peaks instead of gambling on October calendar alone.

Goal: 4+ fish (top 10), targeting September peak with overnight class.

—streaker
